title: aster puniceus subsp. firmus
intro: Aster puniceus subsp. firmus, commonly known as firm purple coneflower, is a subspecies of the Aster puniceus plant, native to North America. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, used to promote overall health and well-being. The health benefits of Aster puniceus subsp. firmus include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
